title: Schedule II prescriptions may not be refilled
rule_summary: Federal law prohibits refilling a Schedule II prescription; additional dispensing requires a new lawful prescription or a permitted remainder of a partial fill.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply schedule ii refills requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Schedule II prescriptions may not be refilled

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing schedule ii refills with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
